owned_invariants: A candidate is typed by the canon's task_value_colour and built as a term.rs operation, so its arity fits its body and an identity keeps its colour.

The host runs a candidate's body on each case's public input and compares with the result of judge.rs on that case. The request cannot carry an expected value, a verdict or a body outside the closed list.
A case is given to a candidate as one IntegerList, or as one Integer per value; any other input shape does not fit.

HOST_VERIFIED: the body gave the judge's result on every case. REFUSED: ill typed, a repeated id, an evaluation error, or another result on a case it fits. UNVERIFIED_CANDIDATE: no body, or a case it does not fit and no case it got wrong.
The outcome is accepted only when at least one candidate is verified and none is refused; the verdict names which of the three happened.
A request with no case is refused: nothing is verified on no evidence.
boundaries: Verified means agreement on the cases given, not on every input. Probe cases narrow the gap and do not close it.
Bodies are evaluated on 64-bit integers; a case value outside that range is refused as CASE_OUT_OF_RANGE, and a body that overflows is refused as OVERFLOW. The judge itself is unbounded.
A verified candidate shows the reply named a correct operation, not that the model used it.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, vocabularies from the canon, exact integers, no unwrap or direct indexing.
